title: Paul Thigpen's path from the woo to Catholicism

tellings.quote: he uh he encountered this stuff, the woo and everything else. And uh the woo led him to search for truth. He found his way into Catholicism.

plain: A man named Paul Thigpen is said to have run into "the woo", meaning strange paranormal experiences, and that the woo set him searching for truth until he found his way into the Catholic Church. Dylan Borland, a guest who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, passes this on from Thigpen. He tells it as an example of the strange leading someone toward religion.
